Name: Stardew Valley Expanded - Finnish
Author: gethel
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Finnish translation for SVE. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Suomenkielinen käännös SVE:hen.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Drop fi.json to SVE "Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded/i18n" folder and select Suomi.
Pudota fi.json SVE:n "Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded/i18n"-kansioon ja valitse kielivalikosta Suomi

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You need both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3974]Stardew Finnish[/url]. 
Tarvitset sekä [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] että [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3974]Stardew Finnish[/url].[/color]
